summary: The set of near points is Q_j·Bx_F, closed times compact.

steps.lean:
lemma Level.measurableSet_isNear : MeasurableSet {g | F.IsNear j g} := ((isClosed_of_entries_eq_one
  (S := unitriGroup j) .rfl).mul_right_of_isCompact F.box_spec.1).measurableSet.congr
  (ext fun _ ↦ inv_surjective.exists.trans (by simp [IsNear, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul]))
steps.claim: {g : ∃ ξ ∈ Q_j, ξg ∈ Bx_F} = Q_j⁻¹·Bx_F = Q_j·Bx_F; Q_j is closed (defined by entries equal to those of the identity) and Bx_F is compact (box_spec), so the product is closed, hence measurable.
